answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a time-locked vault before it can transact, with the stake growing steeply per identity. A reputation prism then refracts that stake into visible tiers: newcomers sit on a low terrace with capped volume, while proven agents climb as their history compounds. A sybil attacker must fund a vault for every fake identity and wait out the lock, so flooding the network costs real capital per clone while honest agents pay nothing beyond one stake.
